reason: The implementing UI owner specified an explicit disabled-export contract for unapplied and invalid drafts before the receiver ran the product.

changes.expected: While dirty or invalid, observation export is disabled and explicit keyboard activation cannot start a Browser download. Pending/error text remains visible, and displayed applied values remain unchanged. A successful valid Apply updates visible/exported physical values and reenables a real observation download. Reverting fields is tested against the documented Apply contract.
